exposure: Vitamin D supplementation in combination with calcium
cohort: Pregnant women in their third trimester were divided into two groups, one receiving Vitamin D alone and the other Vitamin D combined with calcium.
finding: Combining Vitamin D and calcium supplementation during the third trimester effectively reduced the risk of several adverse maternal (e.g., gestational diabetes, preeclampsia) and neonatal outcomes (e.g., low birth weight, NICU admission) compared to Vitamin D alone.
